messages.マッチ勝利で体力の低い味方を回復し、敗北してもバリアと与ダメージ増加で受ける、嫉: A multi-target ZAYIN E.G.O for Envy teams that heals low-HP allies on Clash Win and, even on Clash Lose, takes the hit with Shield and a damage bonus.
messages.勝利時の回復: マッチ勝利後の攻撃終了時に、体力割合の低い味方(2+嫉妬共鳴数÷: **Healing on win**: At the end of the attack after a Clash Win, heals the (2 + Envy Resonance ÷ 2) allies with the lowest HP ratios by 2% of their max HP (4% at Threadspin Ⅲ, 6% at Ⅳ) and restores 5 SP. Up to 3 targets (4 from Threadspin Ⅲ).
messages.敗北時の保険: マッチ敗北時に(嫉妬共鳴数×5)のバリアを得て、メインターゲット: **Insurance on loss**: On Clash Lose, gains Shield of (Envy Resonance×5), and damage against the main target becomes +100% (150% at Threadspin Ⅲ, 200% at Ⅳ).
messages.破壊不能コイン: マッチ勝利後の的中時に次のターンの威力減少1を付与し、的中時に: **Unbreakable Coin**: On hit after a Clash Win, inflicts 1 Power Down next turn, and inflicts 4 Bleed on hit.
messages.パッシブ「此度はそなたが針を呑む番である…！」: 嫉妬スキルのダメージ量+10%: **Passive — 'Tis Thy Turn to Swallow the Needle!**: Envy skills deal +10% damage, plus +1% per Envy Resonance, up to 7%. Offense Level also rises based on accumulated HP damage, up to 3.
messages.嫉妬共鳴を最低でも4は作れる編成で使う。共鳴が低いと回復と人数が伸びない。: Use it in teams that can build at least 4 Envy Resonance. With low Resonance, the healing and number of targets stay small.
messages.回復は小さいが気軽に撃てるので、数を重ねて体力を維持する。: The healing is small, but it is easy to use, so use it repeatedly to keep HP up.
messages.憤怒の耐性が普通なので、憤怒攻撃が多い戦闘ではZAYINのラ・サングレ・デ・サン: Its Wrath resistance is Normal, so in fights with many Wrath attacks, equipping it instead of the ZAYIN La Sangre de Sancho (Fatal to Wrath) is an option.
messages.必要資源は嫉妬5、精神消耗は覚醒・侵蝕とも20。: It requires 5 Envy, with a Sanity cost of 20 for both Awakening and Corrosion.
messages.Ⅱ: パッシブが解放されるが、回復量は小さい。: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks the passive, but the healing is small.
messages.Ⅲ: 回復量が2倍になり、精神力の回復対象も増える。バリアと与ダメージ量も上がり: **Ⅲ**: Doubles the healing and increases the SP recovery targets. Shield and damage dealt also rise, so it is likely worth taking at least this far.
messages.Ⅳ: バリア、与ダメージ量、回復量がさらに増える。: **Ⅳ**: Further increases Shield, damage dealt, and healing.
messages.中指末妹: 嫉妬スキルで資源と共鳴を作れ、パッシブ「怨恨の刺青」は味方が被ダメー: **[The Middle Little Sister](persona:0306)**: Her Envy skills build resources and Resonance, and her passive Vengeance Tattoo grows stronger the more damage allies take.
messages.ロボトミーE.G.O::愛と憎悪の名の下に: 嫉妬のスキルが多く、嫉妬共鳴を作り: **[Lobotomy E.G.O:: In the Name of Love and Hate](persona:0312)**: Has many Envy skills, making Envy Resonance easy to build.
